Create a high-fidelity visual poster for this carousel slide based on the official AI Visual Prompt Cookbook specification: "Acid Lime 3D Streetwear Type Poster Style".

=== [1. BRAND ANCHOR] ===
• BRAND LOGO / MARK: "project\ciel" (lowercase with signature forward slash). Always keep the brand logo consistent.

=== [2. DAY'S COOKBOOK VISUAL STYLE SPECIFICATION: ACID LIME 3D STREETWEAR TYPE POSTER STYLE] ===
• STYLE SUMMARY: A glossy C4D streetwear campaign poster system built from pale studio space, oversized black block typography, acid-lime marker strokes, sticker badges, fashion-tool props, low wide-angle character staging, and clean synthetic product lighting.
• VISUAL GENRE: Glossy C4D youth-fashion poster, streetwear product campaign, acid-lime type-and-avatar social ad.
• COMPOSITION LOGIC: A large black headline mass occupies the left or upper area while a polished 3D subject cluster occupies the opposite side. Small stickers, tools, and props bridge the type and character zones.
• SUBJECT PLACEMENT: The subject sits, crouches, leans, kneels, or poses close to camera, with one oversized foreground object creating depth and scale.
• CAMERA & PERSPECTIVE: Low front three-quarter wide-angle perspective with mild lens exaggeration and cropped foreground props.
• TYPOGRAPHY SYSTEM: Huge black geometric block letters, condensed and tightly stacked, with short secondary type in black or acid-lime capsules; type behaves like a physical campaign wall.
• COLOR PALETTE: A pale neutral base carries black type and acid-lime accents; small hot pink, yellow, orange, or cyan stickers add pop without overtaking the lime.
• GRAPHIC ELEMENTS: Marker strokes, signature-like scribbles, barcode strips, warning labels, tiny capsules, scalloped sticker seals, round smiley badges, hang tags, and thin black connector lines.
• TEXTURE & FINISH: Smooth plastic skin, matte-black rubber, glossy chrome, soft textile weave, semi-translucent acrylic, sticker paper, and crisp printed type.
• LIGHTING: High-key studio lighting, soft floor shadows, gentle specular highlights, and clean advertising contrast.

=== [3. MANDATORY STYLE FIDELITY ANCHORS] ===
• Pale cool-gray or off-white studio background with large empty breathing space around a dense central campaign cluster.
• Glossy C4D character or product rendering with smooth plastic skin, simplified doll-like features, tactile fabric, chrome, and black rubber surfaces.
• Low wide-angle camera perspective that makes foreground shoes, tools, bags, or props feel oversized and close to the viewer.
• Heavy black condensed block headline typography acts as a massive graphic object, stacked and slightly compressed rather than quiet caption text.
• Acid-lime green is the main accent, appearing as fabric fields, marker signatures, object trim, sticker dots, tags, and thin energetic strokes.
• Small sticker-badge grammar surrounds the scene: warning triangles, smiley dots, barcode marks, capsule labels, scalloped seals, and tiny black tags.
• Neon marker scribbles slash across or under the headline as deliberate graphic rhythm, not random background decoration.
• Fashion editorial prop styling with shopping bags, stacked boxes, soft fabric rolls, brushes, cables, sunglasses, headphones, straps, and tactile accessories.
• Commercial studio lighting is bright, clean, and synthetic, with soft shadows, glossy rim highlights, and no gritty analog texture.
• Palette proportions stay disciplined: pale gray/white field, large black typography, acid lime as dominant accent, with tiny pink, yellow, cyan, and orange sticker sparks.
• Composition balances a large left or upper type mass with a right or lower 3D subject cluster, leaving the type and character clearly legible.
• Mood is youth-fashion, pop-up campaign, playful tech-beauty energy, and polished collectible-toy advertising.

=== [4. TOPIC & SLIDE COPY] ===
• HEADLINE (MAIN_TEXT): "NOBODY CARES ABOUT YOUR FOUNDING STORY. THEY CARE ABOUT WHO THEY BECOME."
• SUBHEAD (SECONDARY_TEXT): "Nobody Remembers Your Origin Story: The Psychology of Transformation"
• BADGE STAMP: "DAY 2 // AUTEUR BRAND TRANSFORMATION ARC"
• FORMAT: 1080 x 1350 vertical ratio (4:5)

=== [HIGH-FASHION EDITORIAL DIRECTING DIRECTIVE (VOGUE / PRADA / JACQUEMUS / BALENCIAGA STANDARD)] ===
• STRICT ZERO-REPETITION RULE: Every slide MUST feature a completely unique, bespoke setting, camera angle, and physical fashion/architectural prop. BANNED: Cluttered desks, reused fur/cowhide macros, generic sofas, everyday subway cars, or simple domestic scenes.

• Slide 1 (The High-Status Editorial Hook): Visually arresting haute-couture campaign shoot. An avant-garde figure in an oversized structured Abyss Black cocoon coat and sculptural sunglasses standing on a cantilevered brutalist travertine ledge over a misty sunrise fjord, or a monolithic chrome mirror monolith rising from a dramatic pink Mediterranean salt flat with low golden sun flare. Extreme low-angle worm's-eye view with Dutch tilt.
• Slide 1 Typography: High-contrast mixed typography with varied weights, italics, and discrete architectural annotations: top-left small discrete caption '// 01 · CIEL NARRATIVE CORE', main headline in heavy bold serif 'Your brand' paired with delicate elegant italic serif 'needs to tell' and massive bold punch 'a STORY.', bottom-right small metadata '[DISCOVERY · 2026]'. Pure crisp white (#FFFFFF) text floating over negative space. Zero boxes, zero badges, zero stickers.

Main Headline: "nobody cares about your founding story. they care about who they become."
Highlight Focus: Emphasize keywords "world, founders, destination" in the reference style container
Subtitle / Description: "Nobody Remembers Your Origin Story: The Psychology of Transformation"

Aspect Ratio: 4:5 vertical portrait (1080x1350) for Instagram Carousel.
